derivation:
by simpa [coordinateRatio, Away.isLocalizationElem] using
  (Away.isLocalization_mul (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X R j.1) (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X R i) (x := Xi * MvPolynomial.X j.1) (by rw [mul_comm]) (by norm_num))
explanation: Specialize the homogeneous-localization theorem to the polynomial grading, with f = X j and g = X i, both of degree one. Its localization element g^d/f^e is the stated coordinate ratio, and its algebra structure is the right overlap map.
